=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:745 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The 55 s budget starts when classify_cancelled_run begins, so if both the jobs read and its one retry hit their 30 s subprocess timeouts (about 62 s), the first annotation-loop check returns `unverified` before any annotation GET is made.
  WHY: A slow or rate-limited jobs read gives `verdict=unverified` and posts `ci/final=failure` where a `timeout-minutes` cut-off should give `not_cancelled`; the only rate-limit recovery is a 2 s retry without `gh_retry` (the source rated it NIT).
- tests/test_ci_cancelled_rerun.py:test_cancelled_run_stops_annotation_reads_past_the_time_limit | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test only covers an instant jobs read with two loop iterations, never the worst case where slow jobs reads use up the 55 s budget, and its three-value `mock.Mock(side_effect=[0.0, 1.0, limit + 1.0])` clock breaks with StopIteration if another `time.monotonic()` call is added.
  WHY: The test gives no regression coverage for the documented production worst case (slow jobs read → no annotation reads → `unverified`) that the time-limit change is meant to keep inside the 90 s shell timeout (the source rated it NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "otherwise read the run's jobs once (`GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest`, through `gh_retry`)." — issue #10131, Design item 1
  expected_change_site: scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py — `list_run_jobs` (the helper called by `classify_cancelled_run`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `list_run_jobs` invokes `gh api` directly with `subprocess.run` at lines 512–515, `classify_cancelled_run` retries that direct call after a fixed two-second sleep at lines 747–751 (748–751 per openai_gpt-6-luna) and does not route the jobs read through `gh_retry`, the 90 s `timeout` around the classifier in `scripts/ci_final_status.sh` cannot fit `gh_retry`'s wait of up to `GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS` (default 600 s), earlier rounds deferred this as TASK_GAP_DEFERRED, and neither the script header nor the PR description notes the deviation (severity: NIT per gemini and luna, MAJOR per minimax)
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py:745 (started_at = time.monotonic() at function entry; loop-head guard `if time.monotonic() - started_at > CLASSIFY_CANCELLED_READ_START_LIMIT_SECONDS: return "unverified"`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The budget starts at function entry, so two 30 s jobs-read timeouts plus the 2 s retry (about 62 s) make the first loop iteration return `unverified` without any annotation GET.
  WHY: A slow jobs endpoint posts a false `ci/final=failure` even for runs whose only cancelled job carried a timeout annotation; there is no `gh_retry` integration.
- tests/test_ci_cancelled_rerun.py:test_cancelled_run_stops_annotation_reads_past_the_time_limit (`clock = mock.Mock(side_effect=[0.0, 1.0, limit + 1.0])`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The test covers only an instant jobs read, never the slow-jobs-read worst case, and it silently assumes exactly three `time.monotonic()` calls (StopIteration otherwise).
  WHY: It gives no regression coverage for the documented production worst case (jobs read slow → no annotation reads → `unverified`).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "otherwise read the run's jobs once (`GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<run_id>/jobs?per_page=100&filter=latest`, through `gh_retry`)." — issue #10131, Design item 1; also in the AD-1 clarifier (comment 7172799505) and the "Tests" section.
  Expected change site: scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py — `list_run_jobs` (the helper called by `classify_cancelled_run`), which shells out via `subprocess.run(["gh", "api", "-X", "GET", f"repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/attempts/{attempt}/jobs", "-f", "per_page=100"], ...)`.
  Evidence of absence: `list_run_jobs` still calls `gh api` directly via `subprocess.run`, and the retry is a hard-coded `time.sleep(2)` followed by a direct re-call. The 90 s `timeout` in `scripts/ci_final_status.sh` cannot tolerate the `gh_retry` wait of up to `GH_RETRY_RATE_LIMIT_MAX_WAIT_SECS` (default 600 s). Earlier rounds marked this TASK_GAP_DEFERRED. The last run did not address the mismatch, for example with a header note, and the PR description does not mention the deviation.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_cancelled_rerun.py classify_cancelled_run, `started_at = time.monotonic()` at function entry. Slow jobs reads leave no budget for even one annotation read. Fix: move `started_at = time.monotonic()` to right after the successful `jobs = list_run_jobs(...)` (and after the retry if taken), about 1 line. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- HARDENING: agents.d/10131-final-ci-status-cancelled-run.md and README.md (the `CI_FINAL_STATUS_RUN_CANCELLED_SKIP_ENABLED` row). Neither document distinguishes `verdict=unverified` (the internal 55 s budget) from `verdict=none reason=timeout` (the 90 s shell `timeout`). Fix: add a one-line clarifying phrase to each file (2 lines in total). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
